issues.jp_before: 田中[たなか]さん{は/も|wa-topic}数学[すうがく]{が|ga-stative}好[す]きです。
issues.problem: も listed as an alternative, but it adds 'also', which the English does not have.
issues.action: Removed も from the wa-topic slot.

issues.jp_before: 先生[せんせい]{の|no-possessive}話[はなし]{が|ga-stative}よく分[わ]かりません。
issues.problem: Negative sentence: contrastive は is just as natural in the focus slot but was not listed.

issues.jp_before: この問題[もんだい]{が|ga-stative}分[わ]かりません。
issues.problem: Negative sentence: この問題は分かりません is equally natural; は was missing as an alternative.
issues.action: Focus slot became {が/は|ga-stative}; added a note to why.

issues.jp_before: やっと宿題[しゅくだい]{が|ga-stative}できました。
issues.problem: できる here means 'be completed' (intransitive subject), not the stative/potential object the skill drills; the sentence is also ambiguous ('finished' vs 'was able to do').
issues.action: Deleted and replaced with この学校の生徒はみんな水泳ができます (potential できる).

issues.jp_before: 毎日[まいにち]、日本語[にほんご]{を|o-object}勉強[べんきょう]しています{が|ga-but}、まだ漢字[かんじ]{が|ga-stative}よく分[わ]かりません。
issues.problem: Negative contrast: 漢字は is equally natural in the focus slot; けど is also a natural alternative in the ga-but slot.

issues.jp_before: 社長[しゃちょう]{は|wa-topic}英語[えいご]{と/や|to-and}中国語[ちゅうごくご]{が|ga-stative}分[わ]かります。
issues.problem: や means 'among others' and does not fit the complete list 'English and Chinese'.
issues.action: Removed や from the to-and slot.

issues.jp_before: 山田[やまだ]さん{は|wa-topic}説明[せつめい]{が|ga-stative}上手[じょうず]です{ね|ne-agreement}。
issues.problem: English 'isn't that right?' is an unnatural rendering of ね.
issues.action: English changed to 'Yamada-san is really good at explaining things, don't you think?'

issues.jp_before: 会社[かいしゃ]{に|ni-location}日本語[にほんご]{が|ga-stative}分[わ]かる人[ひと]{が|ga-existence}いません。
issues.problem: Negative existence: 人はいません is equally natural; は missing as alternative in the non-focus slot.

issues.jp_before: 姉[あね]{は|wa-topic}数学[すうがく]{が|ga-stative}得意[とくい]な{ので|node-because}、友[とも]だち{に|ni-target}教[おし]えています。
issues.problem: The person taught with 教える is a recipient, not a target of contact.

issues.jp_before: 英語[えいご]{と/や|to-and}フランス語[ご]、どちら{が|ga-stative}好[す]きです{か|ka-question}。
issues.problem: や is impossible with a two-way どちら choice.
issues.action: Removed や from the to-and slot.

issues.jp_before: 弟[おとうと]{は|wa-topic}体育[たいいく]{が|ga-stative}好[す]きです{が|ga-but}、音楽[おんがく]{は|wa-contrast}嫌[きら]いです。
issues.problem: けど is an equally natural alternative in the ga-but slot.

issues.jp_before: 日本語[にほんご]{が|ga-stative}分[わ]からない時[とき]{は|wa-topic}、先生[せんせい]{に|ni-target}聞[き]いてください。
issues.problem: The person asked with 聞く is a recipient, not a target of contact.

issues.jp_before: 先生[せんせい]、日本語[にほんご]{の|no-possessive}辞書[じしょ]{が|ga-stative}欲[ほ]しいんですが、どこ{で|de-place}買[か]えます{か|ka-question}。
issues.problem: The soft lead-in が (a real particle, ga-but) was not marked; the English 'but where can I buy one?' mistranslates a soft lead-in.
issues.action: Marked {が/けど|ga-but}; English changed to 'Sensei, I'd like a Japanese dictionary. Where can I buy one?'

issues.jp_before: ドイツ語[ご]{が|ga-stative}分[わ]かる先生[せんせい]{は|wa-topic}います{か|ka-question}。
issues.problem: 先生がいますか is equally natural; が missing as alternative in the non-focus slot.

issues.jp_before: 学生[がくせい]{は|wa-topic}安[やす]いパソコン{が|ga-stative}欲[ほ]しいです。
issues.problem: 欲しいです cannot state a third person's desire (it needs 欲しがっている), so the model sentence is ungrammatical.
issues.action: Deleted and replaced with 私{も|mo-also}安いパソコン{が|ga-stative}欲しいです ('I want a cheap computer too').

issues.jp_before: この漢字[かんじ]{の|no-possessive}意味[いみ]{が|ga-stative}分[わ]かりません。
issues.problem: Near-duplicate of この問題が分かりません (one of four negative 分かりません items); in a negative, は would also be equally natural.
issues.action: Rewrote as the positive 辞書{で|de-means}調べ{たら|tara-conditional}、この漢字{の}意味{が|ga-stative}分かりました, focus index moved to 3.
